title: Follow the Foot. Read the Tail.

chapters.title: One run, four views
chapters.body: Mesh2Motion fox · Run · Surface / Mesh / Skeleton / Side
narrationParts: Watch the supplied fox run, using its existing animation.
Four synchronized views reveal different aspects of the same moving pose.

chapters.title: Two paths to follow
chapters.body: Mint: front foot · Apricot: tail tip
narrationParts: Mint tracks the front foot; apricot tracks the tail in profile.
Each trail shows where that bone was a moment ago.

chapters.title: Watch the curves develop
chapters.body: Paths follow the recent positions of two animated bones.
narrationParts: Slow the run and watch how the two paths curve.
Match those lines to the legs and tail in each view.

chapters.title: Hold the paths still
chapters.body: The pose and histories freeze together, then continue at 28 seconds.
narrationParts: Freeze here and look at the shape of each path.
Then watch the run start again as both trails move on.

chapters.title: A history, not a footprint
chapters.body: In-place animation paths, not contact forces or real travel.
narrationParts: The fox runs in place, so these lines do not show real travel.
They track bones, not footprints or ground forces.

chapters.title: Find, pause, compare
chapters.body: Use profile histories to choose a moment, then inspect all four views.
narrationParts: Use the trail to find a moment, then inspect that pose in each view.
One clue can guide the next check.
